newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.African shares end firm on futures-related trade.
newsitem.headline: S.African shares end firm on futures-related trade.

text.p: South African shares ended firm in quiet trade, with golds supported by gold quarterly results and industrials lifted by gains in key stocks.
"There has been a sharp turnaround in the afternoon led by baskets. Volumes have also picked up," a dealer said.
Dealers said there was mixed reaction to the gold quarterly results which were mostly in line with expectations.
The U.S. Columbus Day partial market holiday on Monday muted foreign interest in the market and Tuesday's trade was seen steady, following on Monday's quiet trade.
The overall index added 17 points to 7,051.5 points, industrial index gained 27.9 points to 8,298.3 points and gold index rose 7.1 points to 1,735.2 points.
